recipe.visualDefinition: A vibrant, busy 1980s-style illustrated montage featuring a central romantic couple wrapped in a black pirate flag, framed by a large tan sail. The background is filled with chaotic pirate action, a burning ship, and a bright blue sky with fluffy clouds.
coreVisualRelationships: Central couple as the primary focus, wrapped in a high-contrast black flag
Large arching sail acting as a framing device for the entire composition
Chaotic peripheral action scenes contrasting with the calm, smiling central subjects
Warm skin tones against a dominant cool blue sky and sea background
coreInvariants: A large skull and crossbones graphic at the bottom center
A tan, curved sail framing the top half of the image

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: A man and woman are centered, waist-up, occupying the middle third of the vertical space.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The black Jolly Roger flag at the bottom center provides a heavy visual weight.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: The eye starts at the central couple, moves up to the curved title, then follows the arc of the sail down into the chaotic battle scenes on the left and right.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Minimal; the composition is densely packed with figures, ships, and clouds.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Sky blue and ocean teal provide the background foundation.
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Black (flag) and tan (sail) create structural contrast.
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Yellow and red in the costumes and title provide vibrant highlights.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High saturation throughout with strong highlights on hair and skin to create a 'glow' effect.

letterConstructionRules: Title uses a heavy, rounded 70s-style script with thick outlines
Secondary text uses a clean, high-contrast serif with wide tracking
Title features interlocking swashes and a drop shadow effect
characterSpecificRedesigns: The 'P' in the title has an exaggerated top loop that cradles the preceding word
The 'M' has a deep valley and flared terminals
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: A heavy, fluid script for the main title paired with a delicate, spaced-out serif for credits.
graphicDevices: Curved baseline for the main title

preserve: The wide tracking of the serif text

candidateDirections.reason: Captures the 70s/80s rounded serif-script hybrid feel
Appropriate for the era's high-contrast serif look

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: An 80s gouache-style illustration of a blonde man and woman smiling, wrapped together in a black pirate flag with a skull and crossbones. They are framed by a large tan sail. In the background, a blue sky with clouds, a burning galleon on the sea, and various pirates in mid-action battle scenes.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add a large, arcing, yellow-orange script title at the top with a thick brown outline. Below it, add two lines of all-caps serif text in dark brown with wide letter spacing.

verificationChecks: Is the title curved to follow the sail?
Is the black flag the darkest element in the composition?
Are the skin tones warm and sun-kissed?
Is the illustration style painterly rather than photographic?

adjustableVariables: Intensity of the background battle scenes
Density of the clouds in the sky

mustAchieve: Clear visual hierarchy with the central couple

postGenerationChecks: Ensure the skull and crossbones is centered and prominent
Check that the sail frames the top half of the image
Verify the title has a thick, dark outline
Confirm the background contains a burning ship
recipe.reuseFormula: Create a montage illustration with a central romantic pair framed by a large architectural or environmental element (like a sail or arch). Use a high-contrast color palette with a dark foreground anchor and a bright, busy background. Top the composition with a heavy, outlined script title and wide-tracked serif credits.
